scope: independent scientific audit of frozen G63-v1; no draft edits, new literature downloads, commits, or dispatch

sources.actual_pages_read: arXiv v2 PDF 1–4; equations 3–17, table I and sections II–VIII

sources.path: raw/books/From nucleons to nucleus concepts of microscopic .pdf

validation.angular_control: passed using SymPy 1.13.3 exact arithmetic; 20 q2 and 61 q3 allowed channels, I=0,1/2,1,3/2,2,5/2
validation.assumptions: Wigner–Eckart 3j convention as stated in report; finite angular algebra test only
validation.positive_measure_counterexample: q3/q2^(3/2)=9 sqrt(10)/25 > 1; actual angular variance 0; linearized variance 121/6250

key_findings: q2 intermediate 6j phase fails for I=1 and half-integer channel; final positive expression correct
q3 I=0 coefficient 1/5 vs frozen 1/(5 sqrt(5)); corrected general 6j given
Poves higher invariants use cubic angular scalar; normalized angular width is linear error propagation, singular relative form near q3=0
four Poves numbers verified as model results; SU(3), potential, and rigidity generalizations overstate source
Cline 90–95% and >70% are author conditional estimates; high/low frequency separation has additional assumptions
Bohr irrotational flow, 24 coordinate redefinitions, and D2h are distinct
limitations: Angular checks are algebraic, not nuclear predictions.
Original Cline intermediate-state formula OCR is unclear; stated recoupling was independently derived and CG-tested.
No exhaustive literature survey or new experimental claims.
